findings.reason: The tarball test verifies installation, CLI help/version, and ESM imports only. It never initializes a copied Tauri fixture or verifies the packaged dist/provider bundle, so PROVIDER-AC-4 is unproved and the test could pass with provider delivery omitted.

Only the final allowlisted path is lstat-checked. The source root and parent directories are not canonicalized or realpath-checked, so a symlinked source root or parent can cause readFile to copy content outside the explicit provider source root, violating the no-symlink/out-of-root-copy contract.
